notes.intervals: [median, lower, upper]: 90% credible interval bounds as published (source-frame masses, M_sun; distance in Mpc)
notes.type: by median component masses: a component under 3.0 M_sun counts as a neutron star; typeAmbiguous when an interval crosses it; null when no masses are published
notes.snippet: int16 per detector, concatenated in snippet.detectors order; value (noise σ) = int16 × scale / 32767; whitened, band-passed 30–350 Hz, 2048 Hz; t0 = seconds from the catalogue GPS time
